verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY after work (around 16:30) at Rey Cortiço is the best available option, but it’s definitely a check-first kind of window. The wind looks off for that spot and Surfline consistency is pretty weak, so a camera look before you leave matters—if it doesn’t look noticeably cleaner than expected, I’d skip and save the drive. Tide is dropping through mid, and that can make the Belgas sandbank area punchy (and a bit rippable), so go only if the cams show shape and manageable conditions.
